title: Two-machine workflow: Mac worktrees pushed by wt done, fetched with their tmp/ by ixd review and landed here; ticket mutations commit, pull and push
description:
Decided with the user 2026-10-24 (after TOOL-43): agents run on the Mac Studio; review and landing stay on this machine.
1. `wt done` on the Mac makes a work commit, pushes the branch to origin and records on the ticket the host and the worktree path it was worked in.
2. `ixd review <ID>` sees no local worktree but a recorded host: it fetches the branch into the usual .claude/worktrees/<name> (uncommitted-diff model as for local work) and copies the Mac worktree's tmp/ with rsync over ssh (this machine already has key access to the Mac), so screenshots, measurements and reports show on the page and F5 runs here. Only tmp/ is copied.
3. `ixd land` fetches before landing, pushes master after, and removes the Mac worktree and branch over ssh; `wt archive` likewise.
4. Ticket store: generate_board.py commits each mutation, pulls with rebase and pushes, refusing on a conflict; BOARD.md regenerated after the rebase.
5. The Mac needs push credentials (ssh remote or gh auth; https over ssh failed for autofix).
definition-of-done:
1. A ticket worked on the Mac is reviewed (page with its tmp/ screenshots) and landed here, and the Mac worktree is gone afterwards.
2. Ticket changes made on either machine reach the other without manual git.
3. Documented in CLAUDE.md (user-approved edit).
testing-plan:
1. One small ticket end to end on the Mac.
2. Concurrent ticket updates from both machines.
